method.originalSymbols: Read authoritative Git blobs; derive historical prefix roots from baseline occurrence entries; identify complete uppercase underscore keys and dynamic prefixes; exclude the uppercase product name without an environment suffix.
method.exactReferenceProof: Each original occurrence links candidate+inventory occurrence+baseline line/column to the current token ordinal on the ledger-resolved current line; retain current line hash. The candidate ledger independently verifies the complete bytes/precise anchors.
method.currentByteProof: Prefer the recorded raw SHA-256. A different raw SHA is accepted only when byteExactRequired is explicitly false, actual git hash-object with repository attributes equals the recorded currentGitBlob, and canonical SHA-256 matches bytes obtained by CRLF-to-LF alone. Pinned -text/non-text/original evidence never receives this fallback. Actual raw and canonical identities are both reported.
method.currentSourceScope: Git tracked plus nonignored untracked source, docs and configuration; generated dist/assets/schemas have separate release branding gates. Audit ledgers/exception rules/provenance metadata are evidence, not environment producers.
method.workflowConsistency: Decode all current example/research workflow JSON; compare process.env dotted/constant-bracket consumers with every envFrom target and the three explicit SDK injected keys. Host keys are configuration supplied by the operator.
limitations: Static reference audit does not execute every key or prove scientific backend availability.
Current-only test markers and newly introduced host injections are supplementary, not silently added to the baseline denominator.
The seed environment name is a delegated atomic CPU-job contract observed through the actual tree service; the external scientific CPU execution host is outside this repository audit and was not run.
Runtime probes below are isolated loopback/local-file fixtures, never scientific executions or paid model calls.
method.crossPlatformExecutionProof: Executed Linux source inputs equal actual 05d84e88 Git blobs; generated inputs equal the canonical tar dist verified by a pinned-compiler rebuild. Windows raw differences remain explicit and only actual Git-attribute CRLF-to-LF equivalence is permitted. No pinned -text input is normalized.
